trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the fluke center with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a narrow bounding-box vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations visible along the entire trailing boundary, with prominent individual pixel-peaks (3-10 pixels in amplitude) especially on the interior margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature transitioning to a steep diagonal sweep ending in sharp, tapered distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white pixel clusters (roughly 2-6 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark surface, particularly dense along the leading edge 'knuckles' and the central blade region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Scattered white punctate marks across the dark dorsal surface, consistent with barnacle attachment points or minor abrasive scarring.
